# hostd_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key on the hostd account. Use `id` in `ssh_key_ids` when creating a VM. The API cannot update a key, so changing any argument replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name           = "admin"
  public_ssh_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name (up to 120 characters).
- `public_ssh_key` (String) OpenSSH public key, e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA… user@host`. Supported types: `ssh-rsa`, `ssh-ed25519`, `ecdsa-sha2-nistp256`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) SSH key ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hostd_ssh_key.admin 42
```
